datasets.name: ds_counter_total_dies_30d
queryLines: SELECT total_dies_30d FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_counter_total_dies_30d

datasets.name: ds_counter_avg_fpy_14d
queryLines: SELECT avg_fpy_14d FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_counter_avg_fpy_14d

datasets.name: ds_counter_avg_retest_14d
queryLines: SELECT avg_retest_rate_14d FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_counter_avg_retest_14d

datasets.name: ds_test_kpis_daily
queryLines: SELECT date, site, product, foundry, dies_tested, dies_pass_fp, dies_fail, fpy, retest_rate, fpy_baseline_21d FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_test_kpis_daily ORDER BY date, site, product

datasets.name: ds_bin_mix_weekly
queryLines: SELECT week_start, site, product, hard_bin AS hard_bin_code, CASE WHEN hard_bin IN ('HB_014','HB_021','HB_007','HB_032') THEN hard_bin ELSE 'Other' END AS hard_bin_group, die_count FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_bin_mix_weekly ORDER BY week_start, site, hard_bin_group

datasets.name: ds_param_drift_timeseries
queryLines: SELECT date, site, product, param_code, mean_z, pct_limit_breach FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_param_drift_timeseries ORDER BY date, site, param_code

datasets.name: ds_change_log
queryLines: SELECT change_time, date, week_start, site, tester_id, change_type, scope, ecr_id, details FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_change_log ORDER BY change_time DESC

datasets.name: ds_impact_cumulative
queryLines: SELECT date, site, cumulative_lost_dies, cumulative_cost_usd FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_impact_cumulative ORDER BY date, site

datasets.name: ds_wafer_patterns
queryLines: SELECT wafer_id, lot_id, site, product, foundry, tester_id, probe_card_id, handler_id, sort_date, week_start,
wafer_yield, pattern_class, likely_cause, fail_rate, edge_fail_rate, spatial_chi2_ratio, reviewed_pattern,
CASE WHEN pattern_class NOT IN ('None', 'Random') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_patterned,
CASE WHEN pattern_class = 'Edge-Ring' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_edge_ring
FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_wafer_patterns

datasets.name: ds_patterned_wafers
queryLines: SELECT wafer_id, lot_id, site, product, tester_id, probe_card_id, sort_date, pattern_class, likely_cause,
wafer_yield, edge_fail_rate, reviewed_pattern
FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_wafer_patterns WHERE pattern_class NOT IN ('None', 'Random')

datasets.name: ds_wafer_pattern_weekly
queryLines: SELECT week_start, site, product, pattern_class, wafer_count, avg_wafer_yield
FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_wafer_pattern_weekly WHERE pattern_class <> 'None'

datasets.name: ds_wafer_list
queryLines: SELECT wafer_id FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_wafer_patterns ORDER BY wafer_id

datasets.name: ds_wafer_map_dies
queryLines: SELECT wafer_id, die_x, die_y, bin_label, radial_zone
FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_wafer_map_dies WHERE wafer_id = :wafer_id

datasets.name: ds_wafer_pattern_eval
queryLines: SELECT reviewed_pattern, predicted_pattern, wafer_count, is_match
FROM parijat_demos.mfg_ops.gold_wafer_pattern_eval ORDER BY reviewed_pattern, wafer_count DESC

# Semiconductor Test Quality and Throughput
Executive monitoring of FPY, bin and parameter shifts, site-equipment isolation, change log alignment, and business impact in die loss and throughput.
The MX-7 AUS anomaly (2025-08-18..2025-08-27) should stand out while keeping full-run context.

lines:
## Wafer Map Patterns

Every wafer is probed in one sort session and its die map is classified into a WM-811K pattern class (Center, Donut, Edge-Ring, Edge-Loc, Loc, Scratch, Random, None). The AUS MX-7 incident shows up as an **Edge-Ring** surge on TST-AUS-03..05 with probe card PC-AUS-447 from 2025-08-18.
